title: Compute per-example gradients
prompt: Return a list of per-example gradients, one [B,*parameter.shape] tensor per trainable parameter. Evaluate one example at a time using a scalar loss_fn; unused parameters get zeros. The model must have no cross-example operations (e.g. training BatchNorm). This intentionally slow autograd reference does not populate parameter .grad.
